criteria.description: Correctly identifies that gradient-based optimization only follows local downhill directions.
Correctly connects this to PLAN-01's local-minimum problem in trajectory space.

solutions.fullSolution: Gradient-based optimization (Gauss-Newton) only follows the local downhill direction of the cost, like PLAN-01's potential-field gradient descent. Starting on a straight line through/near an obstacle, the collision-cost gradient can locally nudge the trajectory without ever committing to a full detour around the obstacle. There's no mechanism for discovering that a large, qualitatively different detour would give much lower cost: PLAN-01's local-minimum problem, one level up, in trajectory space.

criteria.description: Correctly identifies PRM/RRT's contribution as solving global topology.
Correctly identifies trajectory optimization's contribution as local smoothing/refinement, and that neither stage needs to do the other's job.

solutions.fullSolution: PRM/RRT contribute a solution to the global, topological sub-problem (which side of each obstacle, i.e. which homotopy class), via random global exploration, which local gradient methods cannot do. Trajectory optimization contributes local refinement: turning a jagged, possibly dynamically-infeasible sampled path into something smooth, control-cost-minimizing, and dynamics-respecting. Neither stage does the other's job: PRM/RRT output can stay jagged, and trajectory optimization never needs to reason about global topology.

criteria.description: Correctly describes PLAN-01's role (formalizing the search space).
Correctly describes PLAN-02/03's role (global feasible path via control-based sampling).
Correctly describes PLAN-04's role (initializing trajectory optimization).
Correctly describes DYN-03's role (real-time tracking control).

solutions.fullSolution: PLAN-01: formalizes the searched space (X_fea/Q_free) and explains why naive grid search/potential fields won't scale or escape local minima. PLAN-02/03: control-based-sampling RRT finds some feasible, constraint-respecting path through Q_free (global topology). PLAN-04: hands that path to DYN-04's trajectory optimization as an initial guess, producing a smooth, locally-optimal, dynamically-consistent reference trajectory. DYN-03: operational-space/joint-space PD-like tracking control executes that reference trajectory in real time, correcting for disturbance/model error.
